DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor) with Paraneoplastic Syndrome.

The imaging confirms a solid mass at the apex of your right lung, and your severe weight loss, burning pain, and weakness suggest an advanced malignancy affecting the brachial plexus. This finding supersedes any other potential causes, including diabetes or steroid use.
